mapper.select: SELECT * FROM media_privacy_consent WHERE asset_type = #{assetType} AND ((asset_id = #{assetId}) OR (asset_id IS NULL AND #{assetId} IS NULL)) AND subject_user_id = #{subjectUserId} AND consent_status = 'GRANTED' AND withdrawn_at IS NULL ORDER BY granted_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_privacy_consent( asset_type, asset_id, subject_user_id, consent_status, policy_version, evidence_digest, granted_at, withdrawn_at, recorded_by_user_id, audit_event_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{assetType}, #{assetId}, #{subjectUserId}, #{consentStatus}, #{policyVersion}, #{evidenceDigest}, #{grantedAt}, #{withdrawnAt}, #{recordedByUserId}, #{auditEventId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE media_privacy_consent SET consent_status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), recorded_by_user_id = #{operatorUserId} WHERE id = #{id} AND consent_status = 'GRANTED' AND withdrawn_at IS NULL
